column1: # The trees this port is pinned to. One `name<space>path` per line; `~` is home.
# IT IS A FILE BECAUSE TWO LANGUAGES READ IT. The pin used to live as a default
# inside harness/pins.py, which meant anything that was not Python had to import
# Python to find out which checkout this port compiles against -- and the Rust
# arm, which resolves its own cites, would otherwise have inherited the box's
# ambient CODEX_ROOT instead. That is not hypothetical: pointed at the shared
# tree, 25 of 35 safari units bundled differently, because the two checkouts'
# DeviceMath differ.
# An override is SAFARI_COBBLESTONE, a name nothing else exports -- which is the
# property CODEX_ROOT lacks, and the reason pins.py SETS rather than defaults.
# THE TWO TRANSPILERS ARE PINS NOW TOO, and that is a change of posture rather
# than a tidy-up. This project used to BUILD its own wasm transpiler, out of the
# ladder's chapter list and a local copy of the harness. codex-zig-transpiler and
# codex-wasm-transpiler now each exist to be a fixed point -- the emitter
# emitting the same bytes for its own source on two roads -- which is a stronger
# claim about a binary than this project could make about one it assembled. So
# safari PULLS EXECUTABLES and builds neither.
# AND THEY NOW NAME THOSE PROJECTS' OWN TREES, not private worktrees of them.
# The worktrees existed so that work next door could not rebuild safari's
# transpiler underneath it. What they actually bought was a SILENTLY STALE
# ORACLE: on 2026-09-06 both still held binaries built from `cc6eab7e` while the
# language pin had moved to `422405d0`, so every arm was grading today's source
# with a transpiler two Updates behind, and nothing said so. A pin that drifts
# without complaining is worse than one that moves.
# The staleness the worktrees guarded against is CHEAP TO SEE and expensive to
# miss: `harness/build_codex{zig,wasm}.sh` fingerprint the binary against its
# tree's own generated source and refuse a mismatch, and every run's PROVENANCE
# records the path and size of what actually ran. `CODEXZIG=`/`CODEXWASM=` still
# override for a candidate build -- that is what they are for, and NOT a way to
# make a stale pin look current.
# THE PATH IS THE PIN AND THE COMMIT IS NOT, deliberately: the tree is a detached
# worktree nobody else moves, so what it holds is checkable with `git -C <path>
# log -1` and does not need restating in two places. Recorded here only as
# orientation for a reader: it currently holds `u56-candidate-sunday`, and
# moving it from U53 is what exposed the quire collision below.
# UPSTREAM NOW REGISTERS `Safari`, `Judge` AND `Gold` ITSELF. Update 55 took this
# port into the depot as apps/safari/port. Both bundlers give the names below the
# last word -- they mean THIS project's directories -- and both say so on every
# bundle rather than resolving somewhere else in silence.
cobblestone ~/showell_repos/cobblestone-safari
codexzig    ~/showell_repos/codex-zig-transpiler
codexwasm   ~/showell_repos/codex-wasm-transpiler
